nodes.name: Theorem 1, Section 4, Section 4.5: Lower bound for the hard distribution Introduced in Proved in
nodes.statement:
There exists a family of distributions $\{\ensuremath{\mathcal{G}}_r(n_r)\}_{r \geqslant 0}$ over tripartite graphs with $n_r$ vertices in each layer, such that for $n_r > r^{4 \cdot 34^r}$, any deterministic protocol $\ensuremath{\pi}_r$ with,
	\[
		\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsf{round}}}(\ensuremath{\pi}_r) = r \qquad \textnormal{ and } \qquad \ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsf{suc}}}(\ensuremath{\pi}_r, \ensuremath{\mathcal{G}}_r(n_r)) \geqslant 15/16,
	\]
	must have, \[
		\ensuremath{\textnormal{\textsf{bw}}}(\ensuremath{\pi}_r) \geqslant (n_r)^{(1/2) \cdot (1/ 34^r)} \cdot (480)^{-2}.
	\]

Claim 4.15, Section 4.4: Distance of $\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}^{\textnormal{real}}}$…
nodes.statement:
Distributions $\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}^{\textnormal{real}}}$ and $\ensuremath{\widetilde{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}^{\textnormal{real}}}}}$ are close to each other:
	\[
		\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\|\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}^{\textnormal{real}}} - \ensuremath{\widetilde{\ensuremath{\ensuremath{\mathcal{D}}^{\textnormal{real}}}}}\|}_{\mathrm{tvd}}} \leqslant 1/n_{r-1}.
	\]
